_comment: Per frame: counts [persons, carts, links] from the HUD, plus the display IDs actually drawn. IDs are recorded because counts alone cannot see one object being tracked under two IDs. `decisions` records the scoring layer — per-cart peak event, owner, abandonment, merch_removed, and the finalised event rows — because counts and IDs alone cannot see a cart linked to the wrong person and scored a tier too low. Regenerate with tests/make_golden_baseline.py; see tests/test_golden_clip.py.
